data.body:
A6-1 reversible quiescence preparation receipts (before publication):

- GitHub workflows Reconcile Bridge (302389202) and Reconciler Heartbeat Canary (302389201) are disabled_manually. Both in-progress queries are empty. Run 30926881507 started just before disable: its reconciler step and ticket commit/push step both succeeded; only the continuous self-redispatch step failed because the workflow was already disabled. No refs/reconciler/lock or refs/reconciler/gate exists.
- Completed green descendant receipt: reconcile-bridge run 30926412447 completed success at github.sha 75cdfec3572197356ece9094f798e5c9d4b1cb21. A6-0a merge is 019e32e03d1be30bb1843f79f22bcc1d1c9a640b; git merge-base --is-ancestor 019e32e... 75cdfec... exited 0.
- AWS timer receipt SSM 0b0cf914-469a-404f-b942-0f225c0914d2: rebar-autodeploy.timer before enabled/active; after disabled/inactive. Deployed SHA observed at pause: a9932c9ad43de90824a600f42bdbabb276749241.
- Host LaunchAgents com.navapbc.rebar-worktree-gc and com.navapbc.rebar-dev-update were idle, then booted out of gui/502; launchctl list contains neither label.
- The global host runtime updater was run manually after the LaunchAgent pause. Stable executable /Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin/rebar resolves through /Users/joeoakhart/.local/state/rebar-dev/current to release SHA 929ba5d66940549857fb5232082bebe94e45d59c; package version 0.10.1; source /Users/joeoakhart/.local/state/rebar-dev/releases/929ba5d66940549857fb5232082bebe94e45d59c.22433/src/rebar/__init__.py. Update log records the locked runtime and Click override from uv.lock. origin/main is the same SHA, and git merge-base --is-ancestor from A6-0a exited 0.
- That exact current runtime ran a temporary real-Git epoch probe and pinned the remote commit while refusing with: store epoch mismatch, local epoch probe-E1 vs remote epoch probe-E2; re-clone before retrying. Probe exited 0.
- Queue-check execution correction: Gerrit search -label:LLM-Review includes negatively voted changes, so pending work is now detected from DETAILED_LABELS by requiring a nonzero current-patchset LLM-Review value of either sign, plus review-bot /health in_flight == 0.
- A new patchset 1365 appeared after workflows were disabled, proving another development session remains active. It is currently awaiting a vote. Therefore zero-session state is not inferred.
- Security follow-up f7f0-8b56-8b6d-4d54 was filed and linked discovered_from after discovering that access logs can expose the webhook credential; no credential value was recorded.

HARD STOP: no tracker fetch/reset, backup pin deletion, rewrite, or force-with-lease publication until the operator explicitly confirms zero active sessions and every rebar-mcp server stopped.
